manifest.json.explanation: Synthetic provenance/checksum metadata has no executable target node. It explicitly identifies the archive as neither a native export nor a customer export.

rules/activities/unsupported-legacy-step.explanation: Unsupported source activity code and legacy database effects are deliberately excluded and never executed. No equivalent external side effect is included in these target scenarios.

rules/flows/done.xml.explanation: Synthetic descriptor manually maps to the reviewed end target done. Target behavior is authored in definition.json, not converted from a native Pega rule. Source-owner equivalence is unverified.

rules/flows/reject.xml.explanation: Synthetic descriptor manually maps to the reviewed end target reject. Target behavior is authored in definition.json, not converted from a native Pega rule. Source-owner equivalence is unverified.

rules/flows/review.xml.explanation: Synthetic descriptor manually maps to the reviewed approval target review. Target behavior is authored in definition.json, not converted from a native Pega rule. Source-owner equivalence is unverified.

rules/flows/start.xml.explanation: Synthetic descriptor manually maps to the reviewed start target start. Target behavior is authored in definition.json, not converted from a native Pega rule. Source-owner equivalence is unverified.

rules/properties/request-data.xml.explanation: Property inventory is descriptive only. Target form types, requiredness and bounds are explicitly authored in definition.json; native Pega property semantics are not imported.

rules/routing/manager-queue.xml.explanation: Pega-like work-queue, skill and identity resolution is excluded. Target approval groups use the explicitly configured local managers group; this is not source routing equivalence.

rules/sla/descriptive-deadline.xml.explanation: Source SLA, escalation and business-calendar metadata is excluded. Only explicitly authored target timers and approval settings execute; no native SLA translation is claimed.
